optimizedContext.value:
# SQLite Graph Store
## Rules
- `SQLiteGraphStore` implements `GraphStore` with `better-sqlite3`; stable backend id `sqlite`; preserves `code-graph:graph-store`. Resolve native binding at `open()`; `close()` idempotent.
- All synchronous SQLite queries, mutations, transactions, schema/FTS work, maintenance, and backend filesystem work run in exactly one persistent `node:worker_threads` worker and one connection per open store; never host event loop, per-operation workers, or pools. Concurrent `open()`/`close()` share in-flight Promise.
- Worker owns native handles/prepared statements; boundary permits only typed structured-cloneable DTOs with monotonic correlation ids. Explicit FIFO serial queue prevents operation interleaving.
- Validate `maxPendingOperations >= 1` (default 256); overflow rejects `StoreOverloadError` without disturbing accepted work. `close()` rejects new work, drains accepted work for `drainTimeoutMs` (default 5000 ms), requests DB close, then force-terminates; unsettled work rejects `StoreWorkerError`. Await termination; no hard wall-clock guarantee during native execution.
- Cross boundary with serializable `SqliteRuntimeDescriptor`. Absolute `modulePath` converts to `file:` URL before `import()`; package specifiers and `file:`, `data:`, `node:` pass unchanged. Worker-path test overrides stay private.
- Unexpected worker error/exit faults store and rejects outstanding work with `StoreWorkerError`; recovery requires `close()` then `open()`, never silent restart. If `close()` starts during pending `open()`, shutdown owns final state.
- Bulk indexing uses lifecycle-generation-bound worker session `sessionId`; only start creates state. Missing/finalized staging, commit, rollback reject. Host states: active, committing, rolling-back, finished. Progress callbacks observational; failures isolated. Closed-store recreation uses non-blocking host filesystem APIs.
- Batch symbol/relation reads and exact `getFilesByPaths`, `getDocumentsByPaths`, `getSpecsByIds`, `getSymbolsByIds` use one typed RPC per logical batch, set-based predicates, deterministic bounded SQL chunks, abstract ordering/empty semantics. Exact lookups dedupe inputs, omit unknowns, preserve first-request order; empty input returns `[]` without RPC.
- Filtered impact applies bound SQL predicates for result types, symbol kinds, included/excluded workspaces; exclusions win after inclusion normalization. Use canonical workspace columns or declaration owning-file join. Constrain frontier before hydration; never pass excluded rows to TypeScript post-filtering. Worker payload/result preserves normalized filter without widening. Empty filters omit predicates; dedupe values; deterministic bounded reads; no SQL interpolation.
- Persist graph under `{configPath}/graph`, scratch under `{configPath}/tmp`; create on demand. Database, WAL, shared-memory, scratch stay under these roots.
- Built-in composition registers only `sqlite`, selected absent `graphStoreId`. Supports durable files/documents/symbols/specs/relations/metadata, atomic mutations, identity-aware FTS discovery, bulk/full indexing, traversal, references, coverage, impact, hotspots, search, statistics. Backend change unreadability recovers through full SQLite re-index.
- `recreate()` only while closed: remove graph persistence including companions, rotate storage generation, remain closed. Map only known corruption/non-migratable schema to recoverable storage-open error after resource cleanup; propagate permission/config/native/unrelated I/O errors. Healthy forced reindex uses open-store `clear()`, never close/delete/reopen. Retry bounded `EPERM`/`EBUSY`/`EACCES` deletion failures, then surface original; never delete live `index.lock`.
- `clear()` performs one atomic logical-generation reset while worker stays open, removing graph/spec/relation rows, observations, coverage, logical symbols/declarations, bindings, reference/resolution facts, freshness/derivation metadata, and FTS content. Cleared data cannot authorize later skip; failure rolls back.
- Persist storage generation (for example `graph/storage.epoch`); expose on `open()` and rotate after destructive recreation so older providers detect staleness.
- Adapter owns SQLite physical schema. Persist `File` (including source content), `Symbol`, `Spec`, `Document(path PK, configRelativePath, contentHash, content, workspace)`, `Meta`; relations `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; normalized/backend columns as needed. Preserve observable `GraphStore` semantics and `COVERS_SYMBOL` metadata.
- `COVERS_SYMBOL` target must be logical-symbol row, never declaration-only row. Same transaction persists logical symbols before relation validation/insertion. Valid coverage survives dedupe, reverse indexing, statistics, serialization, reads unchanged. Reject/report missing spec source or logical target through indexing diagnostics; never accept or retarget silently.
- FTS5 remains candidate path (`MATCH`) for symbols/specs/documents; sanitize multi-token input, join with `OR`, expand via shared lexical policy, supplement identity candidates when tokenization misses strong identity. Rank in SQL using explicit columns/`CASE`: exact canonical identity first; identity non-exact before content/comment/body; exact token > prefix > suffix > substring; real component > arbitrary substring; more expanded identity-token coverage > fewer; BM25 after identity. Generic frequency cannot beat stronger spec-id/symbol-name/document-path intent. `symbol_fts(name, comment)`, `spec_fts(title, description, content)`, `document_fts(path, content)`. Derive snippets and 1-based line range. File content used for snippets is not separate searchable category.
- Transactions remain entirely worker-side; each atomic mutation and bulk commit is one self-contained worker operation, never cross-RPC transaction. Failure preserves committed state.
- Bulk indexing stages bounded chunks into worker session; one SQLite transaction atomically publishes complete session. Reference chunks merge. Emit serializable stages for cleanup, files, documents, symbols, specs, reference facts, observations, relations, search indexes; host forwards optional callback. Scratch remains under `{configPath}/tmp`.
- On open, execute current schema, verify/record schema version, prepare FTS. Incompatible schema may require destructive rebuild. Companion files are SQLite detail.
- Reference schema version is exactly `12`; `SQLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION` and DDL change together. Version mismatch rejects ordinary reads with `GraphSchemaIncompatibleError`/`SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE`; `graph index` recreates derived storage, rotates `storage.epoch`, rebuilds search indexes. No `ALTER TABLE`; never read version 10/11 beside 12.
- `logical_symbols`: drop `member_form`; add nullable `member_kind`, `member_dispatch`, `member_accessor`, `native_kind`, `qualified_name`; equality-index `qualified_name`; update `idx_logical_symbols_member_lookup`; retain `id`, `workspace`, `surface`, `name`, `space`, `owner_id`. IDs use versioned canonical encoding; rebuild discards old IDs.
- Keep current columns for `public_bindings`, `resolution_steps`, `symbols.parent_id`, `symbols.search_text`, `logical_declarations`, `local_bindings`, `index_coverage`, `relations`, `symbol_fts(id, search_text, comment)`. Re-exports/resolution steps are rows. `symbol_fts.search_text` may aid discovery but is not exact-match key; `symbols.search_text` remains expanded bare name.
- Persist logical-symbol, declaration, member-semantics, symbol-space, binding, provenance, coverage, construct/selection range fields with indexed structured lookups. Never parse/substring-rank canonical ids for semantic lookup; backend-local integer joins allowed if external ids unchanged.
- Maintain substring source-content index and bounded short-query fallback. Reverse coverage/traversal reads are set-based and deterministic. Persist observations, freshness latches, VCS evidence, compact unchanged facts. One indexing run: one transaction, set-based endpoint validation, bounded writes, one commit, one semantic/content index rebuild; inserts/selects/worker row shape use v12 columns together.
## Constraints
- Infrastructure adapter only; abstract contract remains `code-graph:graph-store`.
- SQLite layout, FTS, schema, versioning defined here; storage-neutral consumers depend on abstract spec.
- All SQLite persisted/scratch artifacts rooted under `configPath`.
- Storage-agnostic use cases/CLI must not depend here unless SQLite-specific behavior required.
